race.description: Grab Life By The Balls Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ZOUBUCA SHOTS (5) has plenty of early muster and is knocking on the door. Expect Geran to bounce straight to the front from low draw and give them something to catch. THE AVIATOR (7) is race fit, returning from mid-week Eagle Farm where he went too quick for his own good and tired late. Shorter trip suits. FROSTY LOOKS (2) was among the fancied on debut at Ipswich but could only manage fifth in testing conditions over the 800m. Gets weight relief and is a likely improver. SPLICED (6) makes her stable debut for the Vandyke camp off a long break, and while she will likely need at least a run or two, her trials have been solid and Rodd sticking from an inside draw is a good lead. Keeping safe.
